items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Jesse was playing banjo with them. ... I could barely call that whole Golden Leaf band

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And Jesse used to call him Catford, my Jesse used to play banjo. And all them was in the band again. And this fella called, what I called, Zula. This fella was playing Clang at, uh... Zula? No, no. He got killed too.
